newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade steady at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade steady at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 9,800 slaughter steers and 11,400 slaughter heifers early Thursday. Week to date 58,800 head confirmed including 18,800 head or about 32 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1125 lbs 64.00, pen few light weights 1025 lbs 63.50. Confirmed - 21,200
